project: Yuanjiang four-slope arithmetic Kakeya collision-cycle program

wheel_check.decision: Use the existing prover instead of implementing a new Shannon/copy-lemma LP engine.
wheel_check.target_conditioned_copy_precedent: Tao's Shannon-entropy sumset work already uses conditionally independent trials relative to a difference.

psitip_regression.interpretation: The 7/4 bookkeeping needs the copied collision-cycle structure; pairwise invertibility of the five forms alone is insufficient for this Shannon LP.
psitip_regression.independence_boundary: PSITIP independently audits the entropy implication after the arithmetic cut identities are supplied as functional dependencies. weighted_cycle_cutting.py separately verifies those identities on exact copied supports up to floating entropy evaluation.
psitip_regression.numerical_boundary: GLOP is a floating-point LP solver. The positive result is protected by two negative controls and an independent hand-derived entropy chain, but this file does not claim a machine-checked exact rational dual certificate.

invisible_modes.description: A fibre slide preserving C=X+Y at the first C-coloured sibling leaf.
An independent fibre slide preserving C=X+Y at the second C-coloured sibling leaf.

strongest_dual_core_residual.plain_language: The two missing wires are not diffuse. Leaves 6 and 7 can each slide independently while every recorded collision, all seven encoding values and all five anchor atoms stay fixed.

simple_rewiring_gate.mechanism: Replace the root-to-leaf C edge by a leaf-to-leaf edge.
simple_rewiring_gate.scope_boundary: This is a deterministic mechanism precheck, not an exhaustive no-go theorem for every rewired motif.

target_edge_dual_core_gate.construction: Attach one Z=X-Y conditional-copy leaf to each of the recorded five-atom path and five-atom star, then couple the two identical Z-edge endpoint laws over two input projections.
target_edge_dual_core_gate.probability_legality: Each six-vertex local block is a coloured tree generated by successive conditional copies. Every Z-coloured edge has the same standard endpoint-pair law, so the two complete blocks may be coupled conditionally independently over functions of the matched endpoints.
target_edge_dual_core_gate.decision: Stop. The mechanism worsened the best deficit from 2 to 4, so no exact encoding enumeration was authorized.
target_edge_dual_core_gate.scope_boundary: Zero candidates in a width-16 mechanism screen are not a proof that the full 800-structure encoding family is empty. The certified conclusion is only that this mechanism failed the predeclared improvement gate.

combined_conclusion.result: No new 17/10 upper bound was obtained.
combined_conclusion.structural_diagnosis: Ordinary tree copies, including Z-conditioned leaves, can increase the number of target-visible anchors while adding an equal or larger number of independent fibre freedoms.
combined_conclusion.next_required_structure: A probability-legal coupled block must correlate or jointly close the two sibling fibre slides. Merely adding leaves, changing one tree edge, or lighting more anchors is not enough.
combined_conclusion.research_status: Exploratory finite-model computation with exact rank anatomy and explicit stop conditions; not a new theorem.
